supporting_observations.claim: At 13:45:28 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 (10.40.20.20) sent 640,000,221 bytes to PROXY-NWD-01 (10.40.20.30) over TCP port 8080; the connection lasted about 12.2 seconds and received 39,190 bytes. This supports a large transfer to the proxy, but does not identify its ultimate internet destination.
A separate, smaller HTTP connection from FILE-NWD-01 to the same proxy occurred at 13:45:28 UTC, with 1,220 originator bytes and 25,557 responder bytes.
The available network record establishes a large transfer to the proxy, but does not establish whether it was the approved StratoSafe backup or an unauthorized transfer.

known_telemetry_limitations: FILE-NWD-01 winsec and Sysmon collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, covering the transfer; process, account, and file-level attribution for that period is therefore missing.
PROXY-NWD-01 proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, so the ultimate destination, request details, and proxy-side transfer records are not available.
Zeek connection telemetry was available and records the large transfer to the proxy, but the provided records do not identify the originating process or the transferred content.
claims_not_established: That the transfer reached stratosafe-backup.com or was generated by the approved StratoSafe agent.
That the transfer was malicious, or that its contents were sensitive, unauthorized, or exfiltrated.
Which process, account, or session initiated the transfer.
Whether the bytes recorded as originator traffic represent the full application payload or include other protocol overhead.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for the transfer interval, including the requested destination, authenticated identity, URL or method, and byte counts.
Obtain FILE-NWD-01 process and service execution records, especially attribution for the connection at 13:45:28 UTC.
Review StratoSafe agent and backup-job logs for a matching upload, destination, time, and volume.
Identify the files accessed or staged for transfer during the interval and check relevant file-access or audit records.
unrelated_findings: At 13:43:51 UTC, DC-NWD-01 recorded a service-ticket event for svc-archive from IP address 139.162.174.124. This source warrants separate investigation; the available records do not establish a connection to the alerted transfer. (T040-00193)

At 13:34:28 UTC, nora.blake launched Remote Desktop to FILE-NWD-01, and network telemetry records an RDP connection lasting about 785 seconds. This is inconsistent with the stated remote-administration practice, but the records do not link it to the large proxy transfer. Investigate separately. (T040-00098, T040-00103, T040-00108)
